☀️ Your money this morning, Friday 27 November

🇺🇸 US markets were closed on Thursday for Thanksgiving. New York reopens today for a shortened session.

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 closed 1.8% higher on Thursday, led by a 4% jump in resource shares.

💱 The rand is firmer at about R17.43 to the dollar this morning. Brent oil is about $96.51, and gold is up about 1.9% to $3,637.

What it means for you: a firmer rand helps a little with imported prices, but oil is still near $96. On Black Friday, compare final prices and check any pay-later fees.

Prices are 15-minute delayed (06:52). Education, not financial advice.
